groups.defect: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1 instead of Math.ceil, adding a phantom extra page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so Next stays enabled and leads to an empty page.
groups.rationale: All five point at the same lines and report the same off-by-one page count, with the same fix.

groups.defect: The new members routes don't give the add_members/remove_member actions the group id they need: the controller requires params[:group_id], which the routes never supply, and the routes are bare collection-style paths (/admin/groups/members) that don't match the client's /admin/groups/:id/members.json.
groups.rationale: Both report that the routing and the controller's params.require(:group_id) disagree, so real requests fail while the specs hide it. One fix that aligns the route and the param resolves both.

groups.defect: The public GroupsController#members endpoint now always caps results at 50, but the public members page has no pagination, so non-automatic groups with more than 50 members are silently truncated.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same regression in the same action and suggest the same fixes.
